defects.name: re-team gate
defects.rootCause: complexity-gate.ts#readLeadingTeam read only leadSessionId + members.length and never endedAt/terminality; session-gate.ts kept a permanent acted set; no mid-session volume trigger existed
defects.fix: ended-aware and clean-terminal leadership (hasTasks && allTerminal && noFailure), failed task blocks auto-end and re-team, re-armable settlement, per-pre-step volume trigger counted from onPostToolExecute, state in .mpd/session-gate/<sessionId>.json

defects.name: async one-shot consults + 15-minute deadman
defects.rootCause: mpd_role_spawn -> dsh.spawnAgent -> adapter awaited activation.result inside the tool call; the harness runs tool calls from one message sequentially (measured in this session)
defects.fix: adapter spawnAgentAsync on the shared activation arm; spawnAgent is its blocking projection; mpd_role_spawn_async + mpd_role_consult; MPD_DSH_CONSULT_MAX=8 queueing; 900000 ms deadman with handoff + interrupt and a no-age-bound in-flight bash exemption; autoproject slotBoundMs aligned

defects.name: force supervisor
defects.rootCause: watchdog was read-only (warn-only, hold stops NEW dispatch only); candidates() keyed member sessions by NAME while a claim writes the SESSION ID as owner, forcing PREDICATE FALLBACK report-only; projectMpdTeam dropped startedAt
defects.fix: owner identity by name AND executorRef/session id, startedAt/updatedAt carried, wedged decision at forceAfterMs=900000, in-flight bash exempt (recorded), force action via mpdTeamActions with leadSessionId authority: handoff -> interrupt -> requeue -> split -> captain mailbox -> wedged-force journal; captain never targeted

declaredBounds: No live mount boot of the new tool schemas: the tool/knob behaviour is proven by package tests plus typecheck, not by a booted dsh. A mount lane should confirm onPostToolExecute's exec.agent population, the deadman's interrupt path against a real child, and agent_teams_control end authority.

Consult activity is keyed by the child LABEL (roster role name) because that is the only identity the adapter exposes to the supervisor; two CONCURRENT same-role consults share one activity entry, which is conservative for the in-flight-bash exemption (an open bash is never killed) but can delay interrupting a wedged twin.
No cross-process supervision: a child started by another dsh process is invisible to this one.
The Docker real-machine lane was NOT run (this is not a release sweep); the wave changes no install path, patch row id, or packed file layout.

The three defects are committed in one code commit because packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/index.ts hosts both D1's config keys and D2's tool registrations; a per-defect split would produce a non-building intermediate commit. The contract's 'three atomic commits' is therefore DECLARED DEVIATED here.

The captain edited AGENTS.md, agent-references/supervision.md and the incident evidence directly; those are agent-facing documentation, not implementation, and the reviewer was asked to check the manual claims against the shipped code.
